jobs.title: Clean room project manager
jobs.description:
Company Description
CGA AIRTECH PVT LTD specializes in clean room solutions and related engineering services, supporting clients who require controlled environments for manufacturing, research, and healthcare applications. The company focuses on high-quality project execution, adherence to industry standards, and reliable delivery. Team members collaborate with technical experts and operations staff to ensure clean room projects meet performance, safety, and compliance requirements. CGA AIRTECH PVT LTD values professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement in all aspects of its work.
Role Description
The Clean Room Project Manager is a full-time, remote role responsible for leading end-to-end clean room projects, from planning through commissioning. Day-to-day tasks include defining project scope, schedules, and deliverables; coordinating with internal teams, vendors, and clients; and overseeing procurement and expediting of materials and equipment. The role involves monitoring installation progress, coordinating inspections, and ensuring compliance with clean room standards, safety regulations, and client specifications. The Project Manager will track logistics, manage risks and issues, prepare status reports, and maintain clear documentation throughout the project lifecycle. This position requires proactive communication, effective stakeholder management, and consistent follow-up to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the required quality.
Qualifications

Candidates should possess experience in Project Management, including planning, scheduling, budgeting, and stakeholder coordination.
Candidates should possess skills in Expediting and working as an Expeditor to ensure timely procurement, delivery, and follow-up of materials and equipment.
Candidates should possess skills in Inspection, with the ability to oversee quality checks, compliance reviews, and commissioning activities for clean room environments.
Candidates should possess capabilities in Logistics Management, including coordination of shipments, inventory tracking, and alignment of delivery schedules with project milestones.
Relevant experience in clean room projects, HVAC or controlled environment systems, or industrial/engineering projects is beneficial.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a remote setting.
Effective written and verbal communication skills, with proficiency in using project management and collaboration tools.
A bachelor’s degree in engineering, project management, or a related technical field is preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Program Manager
will lead and coordinate the implementation of complex programs/projects integral to the Operations Network Strategy & Optimization organization. Coordinates and ensures effective delivery of programs/projects and activities by cross-functional Operations teams spanning site development, facility design and construction, process automation, qualification, supply chain, digital systems, research and development, quality, and regulatory. Drives planning and effective execution of cross-functional strategic initiatives to execute programs on time, within budget, meeting internal and external customer expectations on quality and value creation, positioning STERIS Operations for future success.

Partners with BU leaders, portfolio leads, and stakeholders (Core Team and supporting functions) to implement standards for effective planning and implementation that are transparent and meet internal/external customer requirements. Ensures disciplined program/project and change-management process and practice is demonstrated cross-functionally, and identifies and implements standard processes with project owners, including reporting and risk mitigation, while safeguarding legacy-site production continuity and single-sourced supply through phased transfer and qualification from chartering through operational handover.

Provides leadership and guidance to the program/project team and direct report(s) to deliver consistent, quality outcomes, protecting single-sourced supply until the receiving facility is qualified, validated, and stable.

This position can be remote in the Central and Eastern Time Zones, preferrably located by a large airport.

What You’ll Do As a Senior Program Manager

Program Leadership –
Drives implementation of multiple, complex program initiatives as the single accountable program manager, working closely with cross-functional teams and resources to achieve program/project milestones within established timeframes, directing roughly forty interdependent sub-projects and twelve portfolios from chartering through operational handover.

Governance & Controls –
Manages the utilization of PMO standards and methodologies — including the PMO operating model, lifecycle/tollgates, project charter, change-control processes, review and sign-off, integrated master schedule, RAIDA (risks, actions, issues, decisions, assumptions) cadence, decision logs, and dashboards — ensuring transparent, disciplined execution.

Execution & Delivery –
Plans, directs, and coordinates activities for complex programs and projects through the development of project plans intended to accomplish goals and objectives within prescribed timeframes and budgets, partnering with cross-functional teams and external delivery partners (architecture/engineering, general contractor, developer, and specialist vendors) to achieve milestones and to quality and safety expectations.

Cost & Budget Management –
Partners with stakeholders, project and business process owners to identify deliverables, milestones, and resources (quality, time, allocation, budget, and information); owns program capital and expense budgets, including estimate progression, forecasting, commitment tracking, and variance analysis, and manages changes to scope and schedule with proper approvals in place.

Risk & Business Continuity –
Communicates with stakeholders and executive/senior management, providing insight on risk/issue identification, escalation, mitigation, and resolution; leads enterprise risk and business-continuity management, including legacy-site production continuity, single-sourced supply protection, and phased transfer/qualification sequencing until stability is proven at the receiving facility.

Design Progression & Procurement –
Directs stage-gate design progression (definition, basic and detailed design, construction, commissioning/qualification/validation) and coordinates long-lead equipment procurement and phasing across the manufacturing and distribution paths; facilitates collaboration on creative alternatives to program challenges with subject-matter experts.

Duties - cont'd

Executive Communication –
Ensures consistent visibility for program and project teams by monitoring and reporting business objectives, program/project achievements, and key indicators; prepares and presents status, risks, financials, and recommendations to executive sponsors, the steering committee, and core team, and develops the cadence for regular portfolio, workstream, and executive reviews.

Readiness, Transition & Handover –
Oversees operational readiness, workforce and site transition, knowledge transfer, and formal handover to operations; removes obstacles and impediments to ensure business and operational objectives are met, confirming demonstrated stable output and supply continuity before legacy ramp-down.

Documentation & Compliance –
Owns quality control of program deliverables and artifacts and the creation and maintenance of comprehensive program documentation, ensuring traceability, alignment with PMO standards, and compliance with company policies and procedures.

Performance & Continuous Improvement –
Tracks and reports program KPIs (schedule, cost, risk burn-down, milestone achievement, stakeholder engagement); identifies and applies best practices and needed process improvements, provides coaching and feedback to project owners and key stakeholders, and acts as a model and champion for continuous-improvement and change-management practices.

Required

The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed

Bachelor's Degree Required
12 years of progressive program/project management leading large, complex, cross-functional capital programs or portfolios.
8 years of experience in manufacturing, chemical processing, life sciences, distribution, or other regulated industrial environments, including site transitions and production continuity.
8 years of experience leading cross-functional teams and external delivery partners (A/E/C, general contractor, vendors) around a common vision.
Advanced program/project management methodology — integrated master scheduling, stage-gate governance, RAIDA, and cost controls; PMP or equivalent certification.
Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, and leadership without direct authority in a highly matrixed environment.
Proficiency with MS Project, Smartsheet, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Lean, continuous improvement, and operational-excellence methodologies.

Pay range for this opportunity is $124,737.50 - $161,425.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.

Minimum pay rates offered will comply with county/city minimums, if higher than range listed. Pay rates are based on a number of factors, including but not limited to local labor market costs, years of relevant experience, education, professional certifications, foreign language fluency, etc.

We are seeking a Senior Project Manager, People Services Initiatives to join Office of the Chief People Officer, People Services, Administrative Division.

The Senior Project Manager, People Services Initiatives plays a lead role in managing and coordinating the key activities of a range of projects. In conjunction with Working Groups and senior leadership, the position will coordinate and undertake a range of activities including, but not limited to, stakeholder engagement, project definition, requirements analysis, scoping and planning, interpretation of legislative requirements, development of communication plans, designs and specifications, training, post implementation support, evaluation and recommendations. QUT is a major Australian university with a global outlook and a 'real world' focus. We are an ambitious and collaborative institution that seeks to equip our students and graduates with the skills they will need in an increasingly disrupted and challenged world.

jobs.title: Senior, Technical Program Manager(CoupangEats Engineering)
jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡이츠 Engineering 조직의 전략적 이니셔티브를 성공적으로 추진할 Program Manager를 채용합니다. Eats Engineering PMO는 핵심 서비스와 프로젝트의 실행력을 높이고, 다양한 조직이 공통된 목표를 향해 정렬될 수 있도록 지원하는 허브 역할을 수행합니다. 본 포지션은 주요 프로젝트와 프로그램의 End-to-End 딜리버리를 주도하고, 체계적인 프로젝트 관리 프레임워크와 운영 프로세스를 구축하여 조직 전반의 실행력을 향상시키는 역할을 담당합니다. 빠르게 성장하는 환경에서 복잡한 이해관계자와 협업하며, 체계적인 프로세스와 운영 문화를 만들어갈 수 있는 분을 찾고 있습니다.

주요 업무

Program & Project Delivery Support

전략적 프로젝트 및 프로그램의 계획 수립부터 실행, 완료까지 End-to-End 딜리버리 리드
체계적인 일정 및 실행 관리를 통해 적시·고품질의 서비스 및 제품 딜리버리 실현
Engineering, Product, Operations 등 다양한 Cross-functional 조직과 긴밀히 협업하여 공동 목표 달성

Program & Project Management Framework

비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

이커머스, 테크 기업 또는 빠르게 성장하는(Hyper-growth) 환경에서의 업무 경험을 보유하신 분

PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe 등 프로젝트 및 애자일 관련 자격증을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

서류전형 - 1차 면접 - 2차 면접 - 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고사항

본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 ( recruitingops@coupang.com ) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.title: Project Manager (Equine-Themed Values Education Programme)
jobs.description:
The Hong Kong Jockey Club

Founded in 1884, The Hong Kong Jockey Club (“the Club”) is a world-class racing club that acts continuously for the betterment of our society. The Club has a unique integrated business model, comprising racing and racecourse entertainment, a membership club, responsible sports wagering and lottery, and charities and community contribution. Through this model, the Club generates economic and social value for the community and supports the HKSAR Government in combatting illegal gambling.

The Divison

The Racing Division is committed to managing all aspects of Hong Kong’s world-class sport of horse racing, covering the full value chain — from importation and training to racedays, equestrian, welfare, integrity, and international engagement. With Conghua Racecourse and Greater Bay Area expansion, we’re shaping racing into a dynamic sporting, social, and entertainment experience.

Job Summary

The post holder reports directly to the Equestrian Affairs Project Manager. He / she is responsible for the set-up, operation and delivery of the Equine-Themed Values Education Programme from December 2026 to July 2030. This new programme is a Charities Trust funded initiative to provide values education based around horses and ponies, working with a local NGO to deliver the programme to schools in Hong Kong.

The post holder will be based in Sha Tin Central Complex at Sha Tin Racecourse. The role will require frequent travelling to other riding schools, Happy Valley, Shatin and various locations for school visits and meetings.

The Job

Lead and oversee the end-to-end planning, implementation and evaluation of the Equine-Themed Values Education Programme, ensuring delivery of programme objectives, timelines, budgets and agreed impact targets.
Serve as the Club’s primary liaison and manage relationships with programme partners (e.g. the Design and Cultural Studies Workshop (“CnC”), the Club’s partner NGO), schools, and other relevant community stakeholders (e.g. the Equestrian Federation of Hong Kong, China), collaborating to ensure the smooth operation of the programme
Coordinate cross-functional support from internal departments and the Club’s equestrian facilities to ensure the effective provision of programme resources, logistics, venue arrangements, staffing and operational support
Working with representatives from the Club’s riding schools and equestrian facilities, design and develop a stable visit itinerary to be delivered to project beneficiaries specific to each facility. Oversee the planning and implementation of stable visit experiences, equine interaction activities and related experiential learning programmes, ensuring high standards of participant experience, horse welfare and operational safety
Provide school-based curriculum development support with regard to equestrian sports and equine-themed education to the Design and Cultural Studies Workshop. Work with internal colleagues to provide technical equestrian expertise and input where necessary
Working with the Design and Cultural Studies Workshop, monitor the delivery of school-based equine-themed values education initiatives to ensure educational quality and alignment with programme outcomes
Collaborate with the Design and Cultural Studies Workshop to lead the planning and delivery of equestrian elements at annual community outreach initiatives to enhance public awareness of equestrian sports and horse culture, including but not limited to mini pony photo-taking, equestrian ambassador sharing sessions, and the organisation of any related arrangements such as licensing
Work with the Design and Cultural Studies Workshop to announce and promote the Programme at the 2027 Longines HK International Horse Show
Monitor programme budgets and funding utilisation, completing procurement processes and financial reporting, ensuring effective stewardship of resources and compliance with organisational policies and governance requirements. Work with Finance to prepare forecasts and complete regular project reports to secure funding reimbursements for project spend
Monitor programme performance through established metrics and evaluation frameworks, analyse outcomes and prepare regular management reports, impact assessments and recommendations for continuous improvement
Build and maintain strong working relationships with programme partners, schools, government bodies, community organisations, equestrian ambassadors and other key stakeholders to strengthen programme effectiveness and long-term sustainability
Collect feedback from project beneficiaries and provide guidance to project staff, contractors and service providers involved in programme delivery
Support the development of future equestrian education and community engagement initiatives by identifying opportunities for programme enhancement, scaling and strategic partnership development
Undertake any other duties as reasonably directed by senior management.

About You

Tertiary education
Minimum 5 years of relevant work experience in operations, administration and/or secretarial support, preferably in sizable organizations
Project management and coordination skills essential
Budget control and marketing knowledge required
Equestrian knowledge or experience a distinct advantage
Educational / curriculum development experience an advantage

Brown & Brown
is seeking a Program Manager – Infrastructure & Operations Portfolio
to join our growing team in Daytona Beach, FL; Plano, TX or Remote
for the right candidate.

The Program Manager for Infrastructure & Operations (I&O) is responsible for the planning, governance, and execution of a portfolio of enterprise technology initiatives that modernize, stabilize, and enhance the organization's infrastructure and operational capabilities. This role oversees programs spanning cloud services, networking, end-user computing, IT service management, and operational excellence, ensuring initiatives are aligned with business priorities, technology strategy, and operational objectives.

This role leads and develops a team of Project Managers, providing strategic direction, governance, coaching, and escalation support to ensure consistent execution and delivery across the I&O portfolio. In addition to portfolio and people leadership responsibilities, this role directly manages complex, high-impact infrastructure and operations initiatives that are critical to the organization's technology strategy and operational objectives.

How You Will Contribute:

Portfolio & Program Leadership

Own and manage the Infrastructure & Operations project portfolio, ensuring alignment with enterprise strategy, technology roadmaps, operational priorities, and resource capacity.
Lead large-scale programs and transformations, including cloud adoption, data center modernization, network transformation, endpoint management, disaster recovery, operational resilience, and ITSM initiatives.
Partner with leadership to assess portfolio capacity, resource allocation, and delivery priorities across Infrastructure & Operations initiatives
Establish portfolio governance, executive reporting, and decision-making frameworks to monitor progress, risks, budgets, and delivery outcomes.
Monitor portfolio financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, capital expenditures, and operational spending
Drive cross-functional alignment and facilitate escalation resolution to maintain program momentum and achieve strategic objectives.

Leadership of Project Managers

Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Project Managers supporting Infrastructure & Operations initiatives.
Provide direction, guidance, and escalation support to ensure successful project execution and delivery.
Promote consistent application of PMO methodologies, governance practices, reporting standards, and project management disciplines.
Conduct regular portfolio and project reviews to assess performance, resource needs, risks, and dependencies.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and delivery of excellence.

Project & Program Delivery

Directly lead complex Infrastructure & Operations projects and programs, including cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, network transformation, disaster recovery, endpoint management, and ITSM initiatives, through the full project lifecycle.
Define project scope, objectives, success criteria, milestones, budgets, resource requirements, and delivery plans in partnership with business and technology stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project plans, RAID logs, communication plans, executive status reports, and other project governance artifacts for assigned initiatives.
Provide delivery of leadership and oversight for projects managed by other Project Managers, ensuring alignment with portfolio priorities, governance standards, and organizational objectives.
Coordinate cross-functional teams, vendors, and stakeholders to manage dependencies, mitigate risks, resolve issues, and drive successful outcomes.
Evaluate trade-offs between cost, complexity, operational impact, risk, and business value to support effective decision-making.
Ensure initiatives are delivered in accordance with enterprise architecture, security requirements, operational standards, and service-level objectives.

Cross-Functional & Executive Collaboration

Partner with technology, business, finance, security, compliance, and operations leaders to align initiatives with organizational objectives.
Build strong stakeholder relationships and provide clear executive communication regarding portfolio health, risks, decisions, and outcomes.
Support portfolio planning, budgeting, forecasting, and governance activities across Infrastructure & Operations.

Risk, Compliance & Change Management

Identify and mitigate risks related to operational stability, security, compliance, and technology delivery.
Ensure programs adhere to governance standards, change management processes, and operational policies.
Serve as the escalation point for portfolio-level risks, issues, and cross-functional conflicts.
Partner with Security, Compliance, and Audit teams to support regulatory and governance requirements.

Validate operational readiness, including support models, monitoring, service management processes, and recovery procedures.
Coordinate transition activities with Engineering, Operations, and Service Desk teams to ensure service continuity and adoption.

Required

Experience leading, mentoring, or developing Project Managers and delivery teams.

Experience with portfolio governance, executive reporting, budgeting, and resource planning.

jobs.title: Project Manager, System Delivery Projects
jobs.description:
At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.

Job Description

Port Solutions Project Management Office (PMO)
is looking for Project Manager
to take ownership of assigned delivery projects for our PMO System Delivery Project Team for Automated Stacking Cranes (ASC) and Automated Rail Mounted Gantry Cranes (ARMG), in order to further strengthen our overall project management capacity.  

As a Project Manager,
you will lead projects within defined budget, scope, and schedule, ensuring Profit and Loss responsibility and high customer satisfaction aligned with the Konecranes Framework. The Project Manager acts as primary interface to customer and internal stakeholders during project execution.  

In this role you will manage the core project team and address the targets and commitments to the subprojects (engineering, purchasing, manufacturing, shipping, and site works). You ensure that the whole project in executed strictly in accordance with corporate values, process handbook processes and contract specific formalities, and engage, coach and supervise the project team members to ensure their performance and individual development.  

 Your key responsibilities:

Manage and maintain customer relationship and communication within the project

Prepare / Monitor project budget and constantly keep the result forecast updated.  

Monitor project performance against the project plan with special attention to customer, risks, time, cost and quality.  

Evaluate and authorize changes that significantly impact the scope, budget, or timeline of a project.  

Know the latest profitability estimate of the project and manage project risks actively.  

Solve and settle the project issues, disagreements and disputes arising from the customer or subprojects.  

 Provide regular project schedule update to management using project tools and communicate significant changes with customers, sales and internal team.

Qualifications

What You should bring?

To succeed in this role, you should understand supply agreement content and can interpret it for the project team and ensure adherence to the requirements and timelines to achieve customer satisfaction. 

Project Management Experience: Proven experience with full delivery accountability for global customer projects involving large-scale, technically complex equipment and automation systems. Relevant certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional) is an advantage.  

Technical knowledge: Understanding and interest of large size equipment manufacturing industry, and equipment design principles and automation systems. Previous experience of automation system delivery projects in an advantage.

Customer-Centric Approach: Ability to understand external customers' needs and customer facing project ownership, adapt to different industries, and continuously learn to facilitate informed decision-making.  

Leadership and Team Building: Proficiency in team management, including building and leading a cross-functional project team. Effective management of relationships, both internal and external stakeholders, including customers, suppliers and subcontractors.

Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (spoken and written), as it will be the primary language for communication. Finnish, German, French or Spanish skills will be an advantage. 

Additional Information

Why join us? 

The role of a Project Manager is unique and provides several opportunities for internal growth within the company. Many members of our management team and business line and business function heads have previously worked in a similar position. Your career development will depend on your wishes and work results. 

What your future PMO team colleagues value most is the project environment, a great product (which we are truly proud of), and the opportunity to work on a global level. You will have freedom of decision and work in a pleasant and understandable work environment with clear responsibilities.   

Want to learn more about the role of a project manager, check out the career story of one of our directors who has previously worked in a similar role and shared his experience: Project Management Jobs | Konecranes 

We offer our employees a flexible work environment tailored to their life situation as well as performance-based incentives, comprehensive occupational healthcare and insurance, and the opportunity to take part in the employee stock ownership program. 

Work location
is Uusimaa (Hyvinkää), Finland where we normally come minimum 2 days per week unless agreed otherwise. 

Travel time:
Travel needs depend on project requirements and customer locations, but typically range from a few days to about one week per month 

   Interested? 

If you feel curious to know more, please submit your application via Apply -link below by 23d of September 2026.
We appreciate early applications, as we will start interviewing on the go, and the position is filled when the suitable candidate is found. So, don't hesitate to send in your CV! 

Have a questions?
 Please contact Daria Zhuravleva, Global Talent Acquisition specialist via daria.zhuravleva (at) konecranes.com

Konecranes moves what matters
. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - AppEx
jobs.description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level.

We are hiring a Senior /Technical Program Manager
for our Application Experience (AppEx)
organization. AppEx is the engineering org that builds the surfaces developers and data engineers love — from Streamlit and Notebooks to Native Apps, Cortex Code, Snowpark drivers, and the developer platform that ties it all together. This TPM will drive high-visibility programs that span multiple AppEx teams and define how tens of thousands of developers experience Snowflake's capabilities every day.

AS A SENIOR / STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER, YOU WILL:

Own and drive complex, cross-functional programs across AppEx engineering teams — spanning application surfaces, developer tooling, AI-powered experiences, and the underlying platform — from scoping through delivery
Partner with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Principal Engineers to define program roadmaps, surface dependencies, and build execution plans that hold up under real-world complexity
Serve as the connective tissue across AppEx sub-orgs (Applications, Notebooks, Native Apps, Drivers, AIML, Developer Platform) to keep programs aligned and unblocked
Establish and maintain clear reporting cadences — tracking milestones, risks, decisions, and engineering health — and proactively escalate when things need leadership attention
Drive cross-org alignment on shared APIs, integration points, and developer-facing feature launches that touch multiple Snowflake product surfaces
Identify systemic friction in how AppEx teams plan and deliver; design lightweight processes and tooling-backed workflows to improve engineering velocity and predictability
Represent AppEx programs to senior leadership with crisp, data-backed status and recommendations

OUR IDEAL SENIOR / STAFF TECHNICAL PROGRAM MANAGER WILL HAVE:

7+ years of technical program management experience at a cloud software company, with a track record of owning complex, cross-team programs end-to-end
Deep familiarity with developer-facing products or platform engineering — you understand what it takes to build great developer experiences and the challenges that come with shipping at scale
Demonstrated ability to work directly with engineers and architects, going deep on technical design when needed while keeping program execution on track
Strong cross-functional leadership skills: you've driven alignment across Engineering, Product, Design, and Go-to-Market without formal authority
Comfort operating in ambiguity — you can define structure where none exists and make progress while not all the answers are clear yet
Excellent written and verbal communication; you're effective in front of engineers, executive stakeholders, and everyone in between
Experience with modern cloud-native software development lifecycle, including CI/CD, release management, and API-first development
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience

BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:

Hands-on experience with Snowflake, data platforms, or developer tooling products (Streamlit, Notebooks, Native Apps, Spark, etc.)
Prior exposure to AI/ML product development programs or agentic application delivery
Experience driving developer ecosystem programs — SDKs, drivers, or developer relations-adjacent work
Familiarity with program management tooling (Linear, Jira, Shortcut) and data-driven program health dashboards
Prior experience in a high-growth, post-IPO technology company environment

WHY JOIN THE APPEX TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

AppEx is one of the most cross-cutting and high-visibility engineering organizations at Snowflake. The team owns the developer-facing surface area — the products developers open every morning to build, analyze, and deploy. From Streamlit's growth as a first-class app framework, to Notebooks as a unified analytics environment, to Native Apps enabling Snowflake's application ecosystem, to Cortex Code bringing AI-native development to the data cloud — AppEx ships the surfaces that define how the world experiences Snowflake.

As the first TPM embedded in AppEx, you'll have a greenfield opportunity to shape what great program management looks like in this org — building the foundations, tools, and operating rhythms that will scale with the team. This isn't a seat at the table; it's an invitation to build the table.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com

The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role:

The estimated base salary range for this role is $166,000 - $238,000.
Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending & health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits.

To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

Job Description:

Are you an Engineering Project Manager who excels at turning complex software development into smooth, predictable delivery across distributed teams? Airbus is looking for a technical Engineering Project Manager-Software
to lead planning, resource allocation, and execution for our software organization, anchored out of Bingen, WA
with teams spanning multiple continents.

Whether you're a former software engineer who transitioned into program management or an experienced technical PM who speaks fluent developer, this role lets you own the project rhythm-bridging day-to-day engineering workflows in GitLab with corporate-level roadmaps in Smartsheet and JIRA.

Meet the Team:

The Airbus Helicopters Flexrotor Program offers one of the most sophisticated small tactical unmanned aerial systems (STUAS) with vertical take-off and landing (VTOL). It can be used day or night by US and allied forces for a diverse range of intelligence, surveillance, target acquisition and reconnaissance (ISTAR) on land and at sea.

Your Working Environment:

Nestled in the heart of the spectacular Columbia River Gorge in Bingen, WA, our workplace offers innovation and the ability to contribute to game-changing solutions while enjoying the flexibility to spread your wings. Whether it's solving complex challenges, or celebrating victories, you’ll be part of a cohesive crew that thrives on innovation and the beauty that the Northwest has to offer!

How We Care for You:

Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.

Your Challenges:

Software Project Planning & Delivery Management - 40%

Serve as the primary Project Manager for the Software Engineering team, owning planning, execution, tracking, and delivery across all active software projects.
Develop, maintain, and continuously update integrated software project plans in Smartsheet, ensuring scope, milestones, dependencies, timelines, and overall status remain visible to engineering leadership and stakeholders.
Track day-to-day engineering activities, issues, and deliverables in GitLab, and translate relevant project-level status into JIRA for corporate visibility and cross-functional alignment.
Partner with Software Engineering leads to establish project execution priorities and continuously reassess plans based on technical progress, business needs, dependencies, and available resources.
Facilitate appropriate software development ceremonies and project reviews, including standups, sprint planning, backlog reviews, retrospectives, and milestone reviews, while maintaining alignment with the team's existing GitLab-based workflow.
Monitor project performance against commitments and drive corrective actions when schedule, scope, dependencies, or execution performance begins to deviate from plan.

Resource Allocation, Prioritization & Work Intake - 35%

Manage software engineering resource allocation across projects, ensuring engineers are appropriately assigned based on skills, priorities, workload, and project needs.
Establish and maintain a clear work-intake and prioritization process so that new software requests are deliberately evaluated before being assigned to the team.
Work with engineering leads to determine the highest-value activities for the team and ensure resources remain focused on agreed priorities.
Proactively identify when new projects or requests should be queued rather than immediately started, clearly communicating capacity limitations, priorities, and associated tradeoffs to leadership and stakeholders.
Support forward-looking capacity planning by identifying upcoming resource gaps, competing project demands, and potential staffing needs.

Cross-Functional Coordination, Risk & Stakeholder Communication - 25%

Coordinate software project activities across geographically distributed teams spanning multiple continents and time zones, maintaining alignment despite limited overlapping working hours.
Identify and surface project risks, technical blockers, dependencies, and resource conflicts early, and drive the appropriate owners toward resolution before delivery commitments are affected.
Maintain clear and consistent communication with Software Engineering leadership, Program Management, Systems Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders regarding project status, priorities, risks, and resource decisions.
Establish appropriate escalation paths for issues that cannot be resolved within the Software Engineering team.
Ensure project decisions, priorities, commitments, and changes are clearly documented and communicated across affected teams.
Provide concise project-level reporting to management, highlighting progress, upcoming milestones, major risks, resource constraints, decisions required, and recovery actions.

Your Boarding Pass: (Required for consideration)

Must possess a Bachelor's degree in a technical field (Computer Science, Engineering, or Information Systems).
Must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience in project or program management, with a significant portion of that spent managing software development projects specifically.
Proven ability to manage resource allocation and prioritization across teams supporting multiple concurrent projects and competing demands.
Demonstrated proficiency in tracking and communicating project status using structured planning and reporting tools such as Smartsheet, JIRA, or equivalent platforms.
Strong background partnering with software engineering teams and translating technical progress, risks, and schedule impacts into clear, actionable communication for leadership and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Skills:

Background as a software engineer or technical contributor prior to moving into project/program management.
Direct experience with GitLab (issues, boards, milestones) as a day-to-day engineering tracking tool.
Experience managing or coordinating distributed/global teams across significant time zone differences.
Experience operating in a company where team-level tooling (e.g., GitLab) differs from corporate-level tooling (e.g., JIRA), and bridging visibility between the two.
Experience in aerospace, defense, robotics, or other hardware-adjacent software environments.
Experience supporting software development programs subject to DO-178C or similar safety-critical software standards, with an understanding of how certification requirements influence project planning, deliverables, schedule, and verification activities.
PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent certification.
Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), SAFe, or similar Agile/Scrum certification.

Minimal - 5% Domestic and International

Citizenship:

Must be a US Person under ITAR definition (U.S. Citizen, green card holder or person covered under our existing ITAR license)

Hearing: able to participate in conversations in person and via teleconference or phone and to hear sounds on the production floor including safety warnings or alarms. Daily.
Speaking: able to speak in conversations and meetings, deliver information and participate in communications. Daily.

We are seeking a Lead / Senior Salesforce Business Analyst with approximately 8 years of professional experience, specializing in enterprise access management, security rationalization, and Salesforce platform architecture. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end business analysis for a large-scale access and security transformation initiative.

You will bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technical architects by conducting current-state security audits, facilitating cross-functional persona workshops, mitigating access risks, and designing streamlined, scalable Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) models.

A strong understanding of modern Salesforce security constructs, Agentic AI/Agentforce, Flow orchestration, and enterprise governance standards is required to ensure sustainable, future-ready implementations.

Key Responsibilities
Persona Workshops & Requirements Elicitation: Facilitate discovery workshops across global business units to define user personas, map core business processes, and establish least-privilege access models.
Current-State Audit & Inventory Assessment: Oversee the extraction, mapping, and audit of legacy Salesforce security assets—including Profiles, Permission Sets, Permission Set Groups, Roles, Queues, Licenses, and Integration/System Users.
Access Risk, SoD & Compliance Analysis: Identify operational risks linked to over-privileged access, orphaned accounts, Segregation of Duties (SoD) violations, and license bloat; produce actionable risk remediation matrixes and impact analyses.
Permission Model Rationalization: Design target-state RBAC and ABAC architectures utilizing Permission Set Groups, Muting Permission Sets, Restriction Rules, and Public Groups to reduce technical debt and enforce modern governance.
AI & Automation Governance: Evaluate and define access boundaries for advanced platform capabilities—including Agentforce/Agentic AI, Einstein features, and automated Flows—ensuring AI agents and automation execute within strictly defined security guardrails.
Stakeholder Management & Documentation: Translate complex security concepts into executive-ready reports, user stories, traceabilities matrices, and change management documentation to secure buy-in from business and IT leadership.

Professional Experience: 8–10 years of total experience as a Business Analyst, with 5+ years dedicated to Salesforce enterprise implementations and security/data governance projects.
Salesforce Security Mastery: Deep functional understanding of Salesforce’s sharing architecture (Org-Wide Defaults, Role Hierarchy, Sharing Rules, Permission Sets, Field-Level Security, Restriction/Scoping Rules).
Identity & Access Management (IAM): Knowledge of SSO, MFA, OAuth flows, Connected Apps, Integration User patterns, and Segregation of Duties (SoD) frameworks.
Methodologies & Deliverables: Demonstrated ability to craft BRDs, functional specs, current-to-future state mapping matrices, process flowcharts (Lucidchart/Visio), and Jira/ADO user stories.
Communication & Leadership: Exceptional facilitation skills to lead workshops with business leaders, compliance officers, and technical architects.

Position Overview

As the core scientific think-tank and executive management assistant to the General Manager, you will deeply engage in the top-level design of the Research Institute's artificial intelligence domain. You will drive the end-to-end transformation of cutting-edge technologies from research innovation to commercial application, oversee major scientific research projects and government-enterprise collaborations, and empower the company to build core technological barriers in the AI era.

Key Responsibilities

1. Scientific Research Strategic Planning & Top-Level Design

Assist the General Manager in formulating the company's scientific research strategic directions and medium-to-long-term technology roadmaps in Artificial Intelligence (including Large Language Models, Embodied AI, Robotics, etc.).
Draft high-quality research planning reports, technology white papers, and business plans, providing rigorous data support and theoretical backing for the company's technological layout and R&D investments.
Drive the breakdown and execution of strategic research goals, coordinating internal and external resources across the Research Institute to ensure the successful achievement of research KPIs and strategic objectives.

2. Cutting-Edge Technology Insights & Research Innovation

Closely track global advancements in frontier AI and robotics technologies, maintaining high sensitivity to technology readiness levels (TRL), academic trends, and industry dynamics.
Deeply participate in project initiation reviews and R&D discussions for major research initiatives, identifying high-value application scenarios and defining visionary product concepts from both technical feasibility and market demand perspectives.
Provide technical direction and guidance to R&D teams, assisting in building the company's core patent portfolio and intellectual property barriers.

3. Major Research Project & Government-Enterprise Affairs Management

Conduct in-depth analysis of policy developments and innovation plans in Shenzhen and Hong Kong within the AI and tech innovation fields, accurately capitalizing on policy incentives to lead or assist in applying for major government research projects and grant programs.
Oversee business and government relations for research projects, building and maintaining long-term, effective communication and collaboration mechanisms with government agencies, top universities, and research institutes.
Execute full-lifecycle management of major research projects (requirement analysis, proposal formulation, progress control, and completion acceptance) to ensure high-quality project delivery.
Assist the General Manager in communicating with external investment institutions and industry partners, accurately conveying the company's research strength, technical value, and growth prospects.

4. Comprehensive Scientific Research Management

Efficiently complete other tasks assigned by the General Manager, demonstrating exceptional cross-departmental collaboration, execution capability, and resilience under pressure.

Qualifications & Requirements

Education:
Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Robotics, or related disciplines.
Research Background:
Strong background in AI scientific research, demonstrated by publications in top-tier academic conferences or journals (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ACL, IEEE Transactions, etc.) or experience as a core contributor to national or provincial-level major research projects.
Strategic & Management Experience:
Prior experience in scientific strategic planning or technology management. Candidates with experience in research planning, technology roadmap development, or project management in renowned universities, top research institutes, novel R&D institutions, or tech giant research labs are preferred.
Technical Depth & Commercial Acumen:
Deep understanding of underlying AI technologies and applications, paired with broad interdisciplinary knowledge; ability to accurately assess the commercial potential and implementation feasibility of frontier technologies.
Writing & Communication Skills:
Exceptional proficiency in drafting official documents, academic reports, and business plans with a rigorous, fluent, and professional style.
Executive Presentation:
Outstanding PPT design/preparation and executive presentation skills, capable of delivering complex technical and strategic information clearly and professionally to senior executives, government officials, and investors.
Soft Skills:
Highly proactive with strong internal drive, exceptional fast-learning abilities, and high adaptability to change.
Preferred Backgrounds:
Experience in overseas renowned universities/labs (study abroad or visiting scholar) or a dual Shenzhen-Hong Kong research/work background is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Research Analyst I - Immunology
jobs.description:
For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Research Analyst I - for our Immunology team at our Safety Assessment site located in Ashland, OH.

Basic Summary

Perform laboratory tasks by various basic methods. Generate and record data with minimal supervision in the performance of studies. Responsible for handling and processing samples and performing accurate data collection and reporting.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
(The fundamental Competencies/Skills & Responsibilities of the role (products and services provided/results accomplished) include, but are not limited to, those listed:

Perform assays such as ELISA, multiplex, immunophenotyping, comet, and micronucleus.
Perform density gradient cell separations.
May act a lead/primary technician on basic studies.
Utilize micropipettes for all assays.
Perform study preparation activities including ordering supplies, preparing/verifying paperwork, and tube labeling.
Receive and log in reagents, solutions, and samples.
Prepare simple to complex lab solutions.
Assist in method development studies, method validation studies, and equipment validations as needed.
Operate, perform quality control and maintenance procedures on equipment such as microplate readers, plate washers, cell counters, multiplex instruments, flow cytometers, freezers, liquid scintillation counter, gamma counter, and eyewash stations.
Maintain clean work areas by cleaning dishes/glassware, wiping down countertops, and sweeping/mopping floor as needed.
Collect and record data in compliance with Good Laboratory Practices (GLPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), protocols, and study plans.
Input, print, and edit basic to complex data.
Prepare materials for shipment and archival.
Review documentation for quality control.
Perform all other related duties as assigned.

The pay for this position is $21 USD per hour. Please note that starting salaries vary based on factors including, but not limited to, experience, skills, education, certifications, and location.

Job Description

(Knowledge, Experience, Skills and Abilities required to accomplish the essential functions) include but are not limited to:

Education: Bachelor’s degree (B.A/B.S.) in scientific field required.
Experience: Zero to two years related experience in biology, chemistry/pharmacy, or similar lab environment GLP experience preferred.
An equivalent combination of education and 4 years related experience may be accepted as a satisfactory substitute for the specific education and experience listed above.
Certification/Licensure: None
Must be authorized to work in United States without a sponsor visa now or in the future.
Other: Proficient in basic technical skills and the operation of data collection equipment. Knowledge of GLPs and other federal regulations and guidelines. Basic understanding of study design and protocols; able to read basic study protocols and extract pertinent information. Must be able to perform effectively as a team member, accurately record data, follow verbal and written instructions, communicate effectively, and interact in a professional manner with management, coworkers, and sponsors. Able to quickly learn and utilize computer programs as needed; previous computer experience preferred.

About Safety Assessment

Charles River is committed to helping our partners expedite their preclinical drug development with exceptional safety assessment services, state-of-the-art facilities and expert regulatory guidance. From individual specialty toxicology and IND enabling studies to tailored packages and total laboratory support, our deeply experienced team can design and execute programs that anticipate challenges and avoid roadblocks for a smooth, efficient journey to market. Each year approximately 300 investigational new drug (IND) programs are conducted in our Safety Assessment facilities.

About Charles River

Charles River is an early-stage contract research organization (CRO). We have built upon our foundation of laboratory animal medicine and science to develop a diverse portfolio of discovery and safety assessment services, both Good Laboratory Practice (GLP) and non-GLP, to support clients from target identification through preclinical development. Charles River also provides a suite of products and services to support our clients’ clinical laboratory testing needs and manufacturing activities. Utilizing this broad portfolio of products and services enables our clients to create a more flexible drug development model, which reduces their costs, enhances their productivity and effectiveness to increase speed to market.

With over 20,000 employees within 110 facilities in over 20 countries around the globe, we are strategically positioned to coordinate worldwide resources and apply multidisciplinary perspectives in resolving our client’s unique challenges. Our client base includes global pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, government agencies and hospitals and academic institutions around the world.

At Charles River, we are passionate about our role in improving the quality of people’s lives. Our mission, our excellent science and our strong sense of purpose guide us in all that we do, and we approach each day with the knowledge that our work helps to improve the health and well-being of many across the globe. We have proudly worked on 80% of the drugs approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in the past five years.

We’re committed to providing benefits that elevate your quality of life. Based on your position these may include: bonus/incentives based on performance, 401K, paid time off, stock purchase program, Health and wellness coverage, employee and family wellbeing support programs, and work life balance flexibility.

Equal Employment Opportunity

This contact is for accommodation requests for individuals with disabilities only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

For more information, please visit www.criver.com.

jobs.description:
Company

Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high-speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short- and Long-Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO and CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $100,000/yr - $120,000/yr

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Analyze security alerts and investigate cybersecurity incidents to determine root causes and appropriate remediation actions.
Support incident response activities, including containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident analysis.
Conduct vulnerability assessments and coordinate remediation efforts with technical and business stakeholders.
Review and analyze security logs from various sources, including firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, endpoint protection platforms, cloud environments, identity providers, AI platforms, and other security technologies.
Perform security assessments and risk analyses of systems, applications, AI solutions, and business processes.
Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvements of cybersecurity and AI governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate with IT, software development, and business teams to implement security best practices and controls (security-by-design principles and secure technology solutions)
Participate in the review, risk assessment, and governance oversight of internally developed AI solutions, machine learning models, and employee-driven AI initiatives.
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, applications, and services for cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data protection, and operational risks.
Identify, assess, and monitor risks associated with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning platforms, prompt injection attacks, data leakage, insecure APIs, and AI supply chain vulnerabilities.
Assist with the development and administration of the organization's AI governance and Shadow AI oversight programs.
Support secure development practices for internally developed applications and AI-enabled solutions, and emerging technology initiatives.
Maintain, optimize, and enhance security tools and technologies to ensure optimal performance and effectiveness.
Participate in security awareness and AI awareness training initiatives for employees.
Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.
Maintain inventories of approved AI solutions, AI vendors, and AI-related business initiatives.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, risk assessments, and documentation related to cybersecurity operations, AI governance, compliance and enterprise risk management activities.

Qualifications

Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or related Associate's or Bachelor's degree.
Minimum of 2-5 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, application security, cloud security, software development, or a related technical role.
Experience with security monitoring, incident response, vulnerability management, risk assessment, and security control implementation.
Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled business applications.
Strong hands-on information security skills and experience.
Ability to work independently on projects as assigned.
Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Proficient In The Following Areas

Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and security best practices.
Familiarity with AI governance principles and emerging AI risk management frameworks.
Understanding of network security concepts, endpoint security technologies, identity and access management systems, threat detection methodologies and cloud security principles.
Knowledge of application security concepts, API security, and secure software development practices.
Understanding of risks associated with generative AI platforms, LLMs, prompt injection, data privacy, and AI model security.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to write and present formal documentation, risk assessments, and executive-level reports.
Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) tools and security monitoring platforms is a PLUS.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud is a PLUS.
Experience with scripting or automation tools such as Python or PowerShell is a PLUS.
Experience supporting software development, DevSecOps, or application security initiatives is a PLUS.

Preferred Certifications

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)
CompTIA Security+
GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
Relevant AI Security, Cloud Security, Application Security, or Governance certifications are highly desirable.

Physical Requirements

Remains in a sitting/stationary position continually or almost continually during the work day
Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually; frequently viewing a computer screen
Rarely lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling objects and/or equipment that weighs up to 50 pounds

The role spans Production, Engineering, Art, Game Direction, Design, Marketing, Publishing, QA, Product, and Player Experience. will lead and coordinate the implementation of complex programs/projects integral to the Operations Network Strategy & Optimization organization. Coordinates and ensures effective delivery of programs/projects and activities by cross-functional Operations teams spanning site development, facility design and construction, process automation, qualification, supply chain, digital systems, research and development, quality, and regulatory. Drives planning and effective execution of cross-functional strategic initiatives to execute programs on time, within budget, meeting internal and external customer expectations on quality and value creation, positioning STERIS Operations for future success.

Partners with BU leaders, portfolio leads, and stakeholders (Core Team and supporting functions) to implement standards for effective planning and implementation that are transparent and meet internal/external customer requirements. Ensures disciplined program/project and change-management process and practice is demonstrated cross-functionally, and identifies and implements standard processes with project owners, including reporting and risk mitigation, while safeguarding legacy-site production continuity and single-sourced supply through phased transfer and qualification from chartering through operational handover.

Provides leadership and guidance to the program/project team and direct report(s) to deliver consistent, quality outcomes, protecting single-sourced supply until the receiving facility is qualified, validated, and stable.

This position can be remote in the Central and Eastern Time Zones, preferrably located by a large airport.

What You’ll Do As a Senior Program Manager

Program Leadership –
Drives implementation of multiple, complex program initiatives as the single accountable program manager, working closely with cross-functional teams and resources to achieve program/project milestones within established timeframes, directing roughly forty interdependent sub-projects and twelve portfolios from chartering through operational handover.

Governance & Controls –
Manages the utilization of PMO standards and methodologies — including the PMO operating model, lifecycle/tollgates, project charter, change-control processes, review and sign-off, integrated master schedule, RAIDA (risks, actions, issues, decisions, assumptions) cadence, decision logs, and dashboards — ensuring transparent, disciplined execution.

Execution & Delivery –
Plans, directs, and coordinates activities for complex programs and projects through the development of project plans intended to accomplish goals and objectives within prescribed timeframes and budgets, partnering with cross-functional teams and external delivery partners (architecture/engineering, general contractor, developer, and specialist vendors) to achieve milestones and to quality and safety expectations.

Cost & Budget Management –
Partners with stakeholders, project and business process owners to identify deliverables, milestones, and resources (quality, time, allocation, budget, and information); owns program capital and expense budgets, including estimate progression, forecasting, commitment tracking, and variance analysis, and manages changes to scope and schedule with proper approvals in place.

Risk & Business Continuity –
Communicates with stakeholders and executive/senior management, providing insight on risk/issue identification, escalation, mitigation, and resolution; leads enterprise risk and business-continuity management, including legacy-site production continuity, single-sourced supply protection, and phased transfer/qualification sequencing until stability is proven at the receiving facility.

Design Progression & Procurement –
Directs stage-gate design progression (definition, basic and detailed design, construction, commissioning/qualification/validation) and coordinates long-lead equipment procurement and phasing across the manufacturing and distribution paths; facilitates collaboration on creative alternatives to program challenges with subject-matter experts.

Duties - cont'd

Executive Communication –
Ensures consistent visibility for program and project teams by monitoring and reporting business objectives, program/project achievements, and key indicators; prepares and presents status, risks, financials, and recommendations to executive sponsors, the steering committee, and core team, and develops the cadence for regular portfolio, workstream, and executive reviews.

Readiness, Transition & Handover –
Oversees operational readiness, workforce and site transition, knowledge transfer, and formal handover to operations; removes obstacles and impediments to ensure business and operational objectives are met, confirming demonstrated stable output and supply continuity before legacy ramp-down.

Documentation & Compliance –
Owns quality control of program deliverables and artifacts and the creation and maintenance of comprehensive program documentation, ensuring traceability, alignment with PMO standards, and compliance with company policies and procedures.

Performance & Continuous Improvement –
Tracks and reports program KPIs (schedule, cost, risk burn-down, milestone achievement, stakeholder engagement); identifies and applies best practices and needed process improvements, provides coaching and feedback to project owners and key stakeholders, and acts as a model and champion for continuous-improvement and change-management practices.

Required

The Experience, Skills, and Abilities Needed

Bachelor's Degree Required
12 years of progressive program/project management leading large, complex, cross-functional capital programs or portfolios.
8 years of experience in manufacturing, chemical processing, life sciences, distribution, or other regulated industrial environments, including site transitions and production continuity.
8 years of experience leading cross-functional teams and external delivery partners (A/E/C, general contractor, vendors) around a common vision.
Advanced program/project management methodology — integrated master scheduling, stage-gate governance, RAIDA, and cost controls; PMP or equivalent certification.
Executive-level communication, stakeholder management, and leadership without direct authority in a highly matrixed environment.
Proficiency with MS Project, Smartsheet, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.
Lean, continuous improvement, and operational-excellence methodologies.

Pay range for this opportunity is $124,737.50 - $161,425.00. This position is eligible for bonus participation.

new_jobs.title: Senior, Technical Program Manager(CoupangEats Engineering)
new_jobs.description:
회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

직무 소개

쿠팡이츠 Engineering 조직의 전략적 이니셔티브를 성공적으로 추진할 Program Manager를 채용합니다. Eats Engineering PMO는 핵심 서비스와 프로젝트의 실행력을 높이고, 다양한 조직이 공통된 목표를 향해 정렬될 수 있도록 지원하는 허브 역할을 수행합니다. 본 포지션은 주요 프로젝트와 프로그램의 End-to-End 딜리버리를 주도하고, 체계적인 프로젝트 관리 프레임워크와 운영 프로세스를 구축하여 조직 전반의 실행력을 향상시키는 역할을 담당합니다. 빠르게 성장하는 환경에서 복잡한 이해관계자와 협업하며, 체계적인 프로세스와 운영 문화를 만들어갈 수 있는 분을 찾고 있습니다.

주요 업무

Program & Project Delivery Support

전략적 프로젝트 및 프로그램의 계획 수립부터 실행, 완료까지 End-to-End 딜리버리 리드
체계적인 일정 및 실행 관리를 통해 적시·고품질의 서비스 및 제품 딜리버리 실현
Engineering, Product, Operations 등 다양한 Cross-functional 조직과 긴밀히 협업하여 공동 목표 달성

Program & Project Management Framework

프로젝트 및 프로그램 관리 프레임워크, 표준, 베스트 프랙티스 정의 및 도입
지속적인 프로세스 개선을 통해 PMO 운영 효율성 극대화

Incident & Stakeholder Communications

장애 및 인시던트 발생 시 심각도(Severity) 기반의 Escalation 프로세스 운영
명확하고 신속한 내·외부 이해관계자 커뮤니케이션 조율 및 리포팅 수행

Process & Operations Management

Jira, Confluence 등 협업, 문서화 및 시각화 도구를 활용한 운영 프로세스 관리
데이터 및 지표 기반의 지속적인 업무 프로세스 효율화 및 개선 추진

자격 요건

Business, Computer Science, Engineering 또는 관련 분야의 학사 학위 이상을 보유 또는 이에 준하는 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
기술 기반 조직에서 Program Management, Project Management, PMO 또는 Tech/Operations 분야 경력 3년 이상을 보유하신 분
탄탄한 프로젝트/프로그램 관리 역량을 바탕으로 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 성공적으로 주도한 경험을 보유 하신 분
우수한 기술/AI에 대한 감각(Technical/AI Sense)과 함께 Cross-functional 프로젝트를 주도한 경험을 보유하신 분
Jira, Confluence 등 프로젝트 관리 및 협업 도구 활용 경험을 보유하신 분
우수한 커뮤니케이션 역량, 조직 운영 역량 및 이해관계자 관리 역량을 보유하신 분
비즈니스 수준의 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량을 보유하신 분

우대 사항

이커머스, 테크 기업 또는 빠르게 성장하는(Hyper-growth) 환경에서의 업무 경험을 보유하신 분
ChatGPT, Claude, Windsurf 등 AI 및 자동화 도구를 활용하여 리포팅, 문서화 및 업무 프로세스 효율화를 수행한 경험 또는 이에 대한 높은 관심이 있으신 분
PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe 등 프로젝트 및 애자일 관련 자격증을 보유하신 분

전형 절차 및 안내 사항

전형절차

서류전형 - 1차 면접 - 2차 면접 - 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고사항

본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.

개인정보 처리방침

쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/

서류 반환 정책

본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 ( recruitingops@coupang.com ) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.
